title: Finance
expectedInputs: Add your file or type your numbers.
subtitle: Give {productName} your figures as line items. Margins, growth, runway, breakeven, and NPV are computed in code; the model only writes the narrative, and any figure it cannot trace is removed.
howItWorksBody: The steps behind a run. Anything marked as a computation is done in code from your confirmed rows — {productName} never invents a figure, and one it cannot trace back is removed from the narrative.
parseHint: We turn this into rows you can check. Nothing is calculated until you say they look right.

upload.label: Add your file
upload.dropHint: A spreadsheet, PDF, Word, or PowerPoint file. Up to 25 MB.
upload.useHint: The numbers go into the box. Nothing is calculated until you read them and check the rows.
upload.warningsTitle: Some of this file was not imported

warnings.droppedRows: {n} rows carried no figure and were not imported
warnings.directionMismatch: {n} rows disagree with their direction label
warnings.truncated: {n} lines were cut to fit the figures cap
warnings.compacted: The sheet was rewritten as shorter period = value lines so it would fit
warnings.cappedCells: {n} cells were too long and were shortened
warnings.piiAmountRestored: {n} cells held a figure the privacy check had hidden; they were put back

upload.pii: {n} personal identifiers were hidden before sending

errors.type: Only .csv, .xlsx, .xls, .pdf, .docx and .pptx files can be read.
errors.tooLarge: That file is over the {mb} MB cap.
errors.failed: Could not read that file as a table
errors.mismatch: That file is not really the type its name claims.
errors.needsOcr: This PDF is scanned. Reading scans is not available on this machine yet, and nothing was sent anywhere.
errors.encrypted: That file is password protected. Remove the password and try again.
errors.slow: That file took too long to read and was not imported.

emptyReady: Check the numbers, then write it up.
emptyWait: Add your file or type your numbers.
autoParsed: Read {n} figures from your brief. Check the rows, then generate again.

params.discountRatePercentHint: Enables NPV / IRR over cash line items by period
params.fixedCostsHint: With price and variable cost, enables breakeven

preview.guardOk: Every figure in this brief traces to a line item or a computed metric.
preview.guardFlagged: {count} figure(s) the model wrote could not be traced to your inputs or the computed metrics and were replaced with “[unverified figure]”: {figures}.

errors.stub: Finance needs a live gateway. Paste a Toko Token API key in Settings, then try again.
errors.addItems: Add line items first: paste figures and parse them, add rows by hand, or pick a saved dataset.
errors.parseInvalidJson: Model returned invalid JSON for the figures
errors.parseEmpty: No figures could be read from that text
errors.docx: Could not build the DOCX file
errors.emptyBrief: Model returned an empty finance brief
errors.invalidBriefJson: Model returned invalid JSON for the finance brief
errors.invalidSectionJson: Model returned invalid JSON for the section
errors.itemsRequired: items are required. Parse the pasted figures first and confirm them.
errors.itemsInvalid: items must be a non-empty list of line items with a label and a numeric amount
errors.datasetNoAmounts: That dataset has no numeric column to use as amounts
errors.bodyRequired: Request body must be a JSON object

pipeline.languageInstruction: Write the title, section headings, body paragraphs, and assumptions in English. Keep JSON keys in English. Do not translate metric keys. Keep every number exactly as given.
pipeline.metricsHeader: Computed metrics (already calculated in code; cite by key):
pipeline.metricsNone: (none could be computed from these items)
pipeline.heading: Heading:

stub.heading: Computed figures
stub.empty: No metrics could be computed from these line items.
stub.assumption: Stub brief: paste a Toko Token API key in Settings for a model-written narrative.

taskUnavailable: {task} has its own steps and its own maths, and both are still being built. Nothing here can be run yet.

statedFacts.title: Stated in the document ({{count}})
statedFacts.hint: Figures the document wrote in a sentence, not in a table. Check the name, or remove one you do not want quoted. They are never added to anything.

cashflow.figures: Or type money in and money out
cashflow.figuresPlaceholder: Opening cash 90,000. Jan in 20,000, out 26,000. Feb in 21,000, out 25,500.
cashflow.readHint: The periods, the two sides and the opening balance are read in code. You confirm them before anything is computed.
cashflow.openingCashHint: Filled in from the file when it already says so.
cashflow.noPeriods: No periods yet. Paste or upload a cash book, then read it.
cashflow.classification: What each row was read as
cashflow.classificationHint: Rules, not a model. Change anything that is wrong and every figure folds again.
cashflow.whatIfHint: Every lever is recomputed in code as you type. None of it is a forecast.
cashflow.whatIfEmpty: Set a lever to see what it does to the burn and the runway.

budget.figures: Or type the plan and what happened
budget.figuresPlaceholder: Budget: Marketing $10,000, Payroll $50,000. Actual: Marketing $14,000, Payroll $49,000.
budget.readHint: Rows, periods and subtotal rows are read in code. The pairing below is only a proposal.
budget.thresholds: When should a line be marked?
budget.flagPctHint: A line is flagged when its variance is at least this share of its own budget.
budget.flagAbsHint: A line is flagged when its variance is at least this many units of currency.
budget.noReport: That run came back without a report, so there is nothing to compare yet.

errors.read: Those figures could not be read into a budget set and an actuals set.

preview.heading: What the rows already say
preview.empty: Read the two sets first; nothing is computed until then.

pairing.heading: Match the line pairs
pairing.hint: Every pair is a proposal with the reason it was made. Change any of them before you generate; one line can only be bound to one other.
pairing.empty: No pairing yet — read the two sets first.
pairing.excluded: {count} row(s) left out of the comparison: {labels}
pairing.meaningUnavailable: Matched on wording alone: meaning matching needs the model gateway, which is not available right now.

appraisal.figures: Or type what you spend and what comes back
appraisal.figuresPlaceholder: Outlay 820,000 at Year 0. Year 1 138,000, Year 2 142,000, Year 5 -65,000… Or upload the appraisal sheet.
appraisal.flowsHint: One net flow per year. Year 0 is the outlay and is never discounted; edit a year to override what its rows add up to.
appraisal.discountRateHint: We use this percent to say what the project is worth today.
appraisal.axesHint: Comma separated. A shift scales the years after Year 0 only; the outlay never moves.
appraisal.irrNotUnique: NPV(r) crosses zero {count} times, so there is no single IRR. MIRR is reported instead.
appraisal.empty: Paste the outlay and the yearly flows, or upload the appraisal sheet, then confirm the years above.
appraisal.noReport: The appraisal came back without a report, so there is nothing to show. Run it again.

ratios.paste: Or type what the business owns, owes, and earned
ratios.parseHint: Rows, periods, signs and buckets are read in code. Confirm every bucket below before anything is computed.
ratios.subtotalsIgnored: {count} total row(s) were left out and never added.
ratios.modelAssist: {placed} of {asked} unknown label(s) were placed by the model at low confidence. Please check them.
ratios.modelAssistFailed: {asked} label(s) could not be placed automatically. Pick a bucket for each.
ratios.unplaced: {count} row(s) are in no bucket, so they are in no ratio.
ratios.periodHint: Every ratio uses this period's column alone. Periods are never summed together.
ratios.classificationHint: Each row, the bucket it was put in, and the evidence behind it. Change any bucket you disagree with.
ratios.emptyRows: No rows have been read yet.

balance.heading: Balance check
balance.ok: {period}: assets of {assets} equal liabilities plus equity.
balance.broken: {period}: assets {assets} are {difference} away from liabilities {liabilities} plus equity {equity}. Fix the buckets before reading the ratios.
balance.unknown: {period}: not enough rows to check the balance.

supporting.heading: Supporting figures
supporting.hint: Only used when no row carries them. A confirmed row always wins.

bands.heading: Reference bands
bands.hint: General rule-of-thumb thresholds, not an industry benchmark and not financial advice. Change any line and the scorecard moves with it.

scorecard.heading: Scorecard
scorecard.empty: No ratio could be computed from these rows.

guide.lead: What do you want to do?
guide.numbersLead: Add your file or type your numbers.
guide.resultLead: Here is the result. Download it, or open More options to write it again.

steps.choose: What do you want to do?

terms.brief: This is a financial brief. Margins and runway are worked out for you.
terms.cashflow: Cash flow. Burn is how fast the cash falls. Runway is how many months are left.
terms.budget: Budget versus actual. A line is marked when it goes past the limit you set.
terms.appraisal: An investment check. NPV is what the project is worth today. Payback is how soon the money comes back.
terms.ratios: A health check. Ratios compare what the business owns, owes, and earns.

brief.label: Explain my numbers
brief.hint: A short written summary of how the business is doing.

cashflow.label: How long will the cash last?
cashflow.hint: Money in and money out, month by month.

budget.label: Plan versus what happened
budget.hint: Which lines went past the plan.

appraisal.label: Is this project worth it?
appraisal.hint: The money you spend, then the money that comes back each year.

ratios.label: Is the business healthy?
ratios.hint: From a balance sheet and a profit statement.

phases.monthly-flows: Monthly in and out + opening cash

export.failed: Could not build the export file

notice.pii: {n} personal identifiers were hidden before anything was sent

charts.heading: Charts
charts.empty: No chart could be built from these figures.

rows.derivedHint: These are sums of the rows above them. They are kept for reference and never added again.
rows.statedFactsHint: Figures the file states in a sentence rather than in a table.
rows.removedSentence: One sentence was removed because its figure could not be traced.
